name: Active Directory service status
description: Latest reported state of the AD-related services listed in the workbook.
kql:
ConfigurationData
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where ConfigDataType == "WindowsServices"
| where SvcDisplayName in ("Active Directory Domain Services", "Kerberos Key Distribution Center",
    "DNS Server", "Intersite Messaging", "Netlogon", "DFS Replication",
    "Azure Advanced Threat Protection Sensor", "Snare")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SvcDisplayName
| project Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Computer, SvcDisplayName, SvcState, SvcState__Status = SvcState
| order by Computer asc, SvcDisplayName asc
